sections.description: Independent GRID-Arendal visitor reading preferences. No automated WCAG compliance claim.
sections.changelog:
Constrains the GRID-Arendal administration-menu flower to the standard 20 × 20 pixel size, including folded menus.

Includes credential-free public release updates introduced in 1.11.0. Websites do not need GitHub accounts or access tokens.

Adds a Reset button beside Website language that restores the original language through the official GTranslate selector. The button stays disabled if translation is unavailable.
